title: Bootstrap flywheel-first planning repository
objective: Establish the minimal cold-start, canonical spec, work graph, evidence, memory, triage, and doctor surfaces.
acceptance: Cold agent has one obvious entry point
Work graph is machine-readable
Generated frontier names one highest-value READY item
Doctor can detect malformed work graph state
strongest_falsifier: A fresh agent must recursively read the repository or guess what work is current.

title: Import complete Rising Sea planning corpus with provenance
objective: Ingest the existing Rising Sea planning artifacts as immutable source material without turning historical documents into current authority.
acceptance: Every imported source has path or URI, SHA-256, source kind, and disposition
Current and historical planning artifacts remain distinguishable
No source is silently rewritten during import
A source inventory can be regenerated deterministically
Every source required for downstream compilation is retrieval-complete for a fresh agent
strongest_falsifier: An imported document cannot be traced back to its exact original bytes or a stable independently retrievable external reference.
next_action: Read evidence/receipts/RS-W001.json; retrieval completeness continues in RS-W001B.
partial_reason: Source registration and current agent-layer vendoring are established; base-system vendoring remains incomplete.

title: Make registered Rising Sea corpus retrieval-complete
objective: Ensure every source needed for canonical-spec compilation is either vendored byte-for-byte in the repository or points to a stable independently retrievable external object with an anchored digest.
acceptance: No source needed by RS-W002 remains REGISTERED_ONLY
Every VENDORED source rehashes to the registry SHA-256
Every EXTERNAL source has a stable independently retrievable URI and anchored digest
Large bundle sources may be represented by retrieval-complete constituent artifacts rather than duplicated archives when the mapping is explicit
A fresh GitHub-only agent can obtain every source required to compile current specs
strongest_falsifier: A source required by RS-W002 can only be recovered from prior chat context or an unavailable transient artifact URI.
next_action: Continue base-system vendoring according to sources/compile-inputs.json and close only on check_compile_inputs.py --require-complete.

title: Compile imported corpus into canonical current specs
objective: Reduce the imported corpus to one current semantic representation per durable concept while retaining citations and supersession links.
acceptance: One canonical current representation per durable concept
Historical sources remain recoverable
Conflicting claims are explicit
UNKNOWN is preserved
Canonical specs cite source IDs
Expert-domain specs compile into DomainMachine contracts rather than prose-only expertise
strongest_falsifier: Two current pages independently claim authority over the same semantic object without an explicit relationship.

title: Compile dependency-aware implementation work graph
objective: Turn canonical specs into self-contained implementation packets with explicit dependencies, witnesses, falsifiers, acceptance criteria and bounded reasoning demand.
acceptance: Workers do not need the original corpus
Dependency graph is acyclic or cycles are explicit failures
Every ready packet has testable acceptance criteria
Critical path and blockers are mechanically derivable
No packet contains an unresolved architecture choice
strongest_falsifier: A worker must infer a hidden dependency, design choice or verification oracle to execute a packet.
next_action: Blocked until canonical specs and WorkPacket lowering are complete.

title: Run matched cold-agent flywheel navigation benchmark
objective: Measure whether the repository actually reduces context, navigation, recovery and decision cost rather than assuming ergonomics from design.
acceptance: Matched tasks use fixed success criteria
Pages read, tokens, errors, time-to-next-action and recovery are measured separately
No scalar winner is asserted without explicit weights
strongest_falsifier: The compiled control surface consumes equal or greater resources without improving correctness or recoverability.
next_action: Blocked until the expert-control benchmark and executable work graph exist.

title: Implement DomainMachine contract and registry validator
objective: Create the machine contract that encodes expert-native representations, diagnostics, repair/oracle routes, ruin boundaries and donors for each domain.
acceptance: DomainMachine schema and registry exist
Three real domain machines validate: planning, external-effect, security
Every donor declares repository, mechanism, adoption mode and claim boundary
Every machine has an unresolved/discovery route
CI rejects duplicate IDs, missing machine files and incomplete donor contracts
strongest_falsifier: A domain machine can validate while omitting the representation or route needed to handle an unresolved case.

title: Implement capability and truth-source observation
objective: Observe capabilities, truth-source class, readiness and degradation without inferring live state from documentation.
acceptance: OBSERVED, DOCUMENTED, UNAVAILABLE and UNKNOWN remain distinct
Missing donor tool degrades explicitly
Every degradation includes a repair command where known
strongest_falsifier: The system reports a capability as available solely because a document says it exists.

title: Implement RuinGuard adapter boundary
objective: Fail closed on ruin-class operations using DCG/FCP-style mechanical enforcement before ordinary action selection.
acceptance: Destructive Git/filesystem/database and scope-explosion fixtures are blocked or require review
Safe reads remain allowed
Malformed classification never silently allows
strongest_falsifier: An unclassified potentially catastrophic operation reaches execution as allowed.
next_action: Write and observe failing ruin-guard fixtures for destructive Git/filesystem/database operations, scope explosion, malformed input, and safe reads before adding guard rules.

title: Implement deterministic expert router
objective: Route problems through the cheapest sound deterministic mechanism before semantic/model fallback.
acceptance: Deterministic routes outrank LLM fallback
Incomplete search miss remains UNKNOWN
Degraded semantic search falls back explicitly
strongest_falsifier: The router invokes an LLM while an applicable deterministic route is available.
next_action: Blocked until truth and ruin layers exist.

title: Implement expert diagnostic compiler
objective: Compile typed problem instances into invariant-backed SATISFIED/DEFECT/EVIDENCE_GAP/BLOCKED/CONTRADICTED/UNKNOWN states.
acceptance: Deterministic invariant violations produce DEFECT
Missing observations produce EVIDENCE_GAP
Model fallback cannot directly set a terminal verdict
strongest_falsifier: A candidate model diagnosis changes the accepted problem verdict without an independent witness.

title: Implement repair recipe and verification-oracle registry
objective: Represent expert repair as bounded transition contracts with exact preconditions, actions, oracles, falsifiers, recovery and authority.
acceptance: Every recipe names an exact verification oracle
Unknown preconditions block recipe selection
Ruin class and authority are explicit
strongest_falsifier: A repair can be selected without a defined proof of completion.

title: Implement unresolved discovery engine
objective: When normal repair cannot resolve a problem, preserve rivals and mechanically seek discriminating evidence instead of improvising.
acceptance: Prior exact cases and exemplars are searched before new generation
At least two live rivals are preserved until evidence dominates
APR convergence does not upgrade truth
New distinctions can emit checker/rule/representation/recipe candidates
strongest_falsifier: The discovery engine collapses an unresolved rival set to one answer without new evidence.
next_action: Blocked until normal diagnostic and repair paths exist.

title: Implement obligation residual compiler
objective: Partition obligations totally and disjointly, sending only UNSATISFIED obligations into executable TODO candidates.
acceptance: Partition is total and disjoint
Only UNSATISFIED enters TODO candidates
CONTRADICTED and UNKNOWN remain separate frontier classes
strongest_falsifier: An UNKNOWN or contradicted obligation is emitted as an executable TODO.
next_action: Blocked until diagnosis and discovery contracts exist.

title: Implement frontier-resolved WorkPacket lowering
objective: Lower residual obligations into packets a simple executor can run without architecture, scope, test or recovery decisions.
acceptance: Packets with unresolved design alternatives are rejected
Reasoning-debt vector is below release threshold
Execution grammar is READ-CHECK-CHANGE-VERIFY-RECEIPT-STOP
strongest_falsifier: A worker must make an undeclared design, scope or verification decision during packet execution.
next_action: Blocked until residual obligations and recipe contracts exist.

title: Implement external-effect reconciliation adapter
objective: Keep exact intent, attempt, observation and reconciliation as separate mechanically checked states.
acceptance: Attempt without intent is rejected
Unknown effect outcome cannot become success
Retry after ambiguous outcome routes to observation/reconciliation first
strongest_falsifier: A timeout, 2xx, exit zero or missing error becomes accepted external success without authoritative observation.
next_action: Blocked until guard, recipe and WorkPacket layers exist.

title: Implement procedural expertise compiler
objective: Compile validated repeated expert reasoning into scoped rules, recipes, negative memos and guard candidates without self-promotion.
acceptance: Harmful evidence demotes faster than helpful evidence promotes
Catastrophic failure emits immediate negative/guard candidate
No memory self-promotes
strongest_falsifier: A learned rule becomes authoritative without promotion evidence and scope validation.
next_action: Blocked until discovery and effect evidence exist.

title: Implement novice expert-control surface
objective: Project expert-native state into a novice-facing Problem/Why/Known/Missing/Do-not/Next/Proof/If-unresolved surface with exact drill-down.
acceptance: Expert jargon is optional by default
Exact domain representation remains drillable
Ruin warnings cannot be removed by compact mode
strongest_falsifier: A novice must understand the underlying expert vocabulary to select the safe next action.
next_action: Blocked until expert machine, diagnosis, repair, discovery and packet layers exist.

title: Run adversarial expert-control benchmark
objective: Falsify the expert-control architecture across multiple domains, degraded states, semantic conflicts and ruin attempts.
acceptance: Matched domain fixtures cover build, database, security, planning, external effect, knowledge conflict and reliability
Malformed/stale/missing-tool/contradictory/ruin cases are included
Correctness, recovery, deterministic-route rate, model fallback and catastrophic-policy violations are reported separately
strongest_falsifier: Compiled control performs no better than baseline or permits a catastrophic-policy violation.
next_action: Blocked until all expert-control components exist.
